newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Autoindustries to buy Australian firm.
newsitem.headline: Autoindustries to buy Australian firm.

text.p: Autoindustries Ventures Bhd, which debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on Wednesday, said it has signed an agreement to acquire an Australian firm for A$5.0 million.

Its merchant banker said in a statement to the KLSE that Autoindustries has signed a memorandum of understanding with James N Kirby Pty Ltd of Australia to acquire Preslite Australia, a division of Kirby.
The statement said Preslite was involved in the design and manufacture of low voltage, direct current, permanent magnet electric motors and electrical equipment.
The company said the acquisition will give it access to the Australian automotive components market.
Autoindustries shares made their debut on KLSE at 8.0 ringgit against an offer price of 2.90 each.
